evidence_excerpts: The search space has two levels: sketches for high-level structures and annotations for low-level choices such as tile size, parallelism, and unrolling.

text: Ansor's two-level sketch-and-annotation representation expands tensor-program search coverage beyond manual templates and early-pruned sequential construction.
